Case Studies / Hotel Name Badges

Published August 13, 2026

Hospitality badge project

Hotel name badges for front desk, restaurant and housekeeping uniforms.

A hospitality buyer needed custom hotel name badges that looked consistent across departments, supported employee name changes and could be reordered without rebuilding the artwork each time.

Request Similar QuoteView Hotel Name BadgesContact on WhatsApp

Project need

The buying problem behind this order.

The buyer needed a professional badge that would not damage uniforms, could carry each employee name clearly and would still match future reorder batches.

The quote process focused on artwork clarity, size, material, finish, mounting method, packing, MOQ and production timing. These are the details most B2B buyers should prepare before sampling.

  • Product type: brushed metal hotel name badges.
  • Material: stainless steel, brass, aluminum or plated zinc alloy.
  • Finish: brushed silver, brushed gold, printed logo or engraved name text.
  • Backing: magnetic back for uniforms, with pin or clip options if needed.
  • MOQ: typical starting quantity is 100 pieces per design.
  • Timing: about 7 days for sample and about 15 days for bulk production after approval.

Manufacturing decisions

Key decisions before sampling.

These decisions affect price, sample accuracy and repeat production consistency.

Name Data

The buyer supplied employee names, departments and roles in a spreadsheet so production artwork could be checked before engraving.

Uniform Backing

Magnetic backs were selected to avoid holes in front desk and restaurant uniforms.

Reorder Template

Logo position, name line, title line and finish were kept as a template for later staff additions.

Quote checklist

Information needed for a similar project.

Send these details so the first quote is closer to production reality.

Artwork Files

Send PSD, PDF, AI or clear reference images with logo, text layout, color notes and any brand requirements.

Product Details

Confirm size, thickness, quantity, material, finish, backing or mounting method and whether variable data is needed.

Packing and Timing

Confirm individual bags, backing cards, boxes, export cartons and required delivery schedule before production starts.

FAQ

Hotel Name Badges case questions.

Can hotel badges include different employee names?

Yes. Names and departments can be produced from a spreadsheet and checked in the proof stage.

Which backing is common for hotel uniforms?

Magnetic backing is common because it avoids pin holes in shirts, jackets and hospitality uniforms.

Can later reorders match the first batch?

Yes. The approved layout, finish and backing can be kept as a reorder template.
